quality_notes: Round 3 Moreirense–SL Benfica is postponed to 2026-09-09 and is not treated as an unreviewed played match.

The 9' Igor Julião incident remains candidate-only because sufficient named-expert provenance for that exact incident was not independently recovered; it is excluded from public totals.

Sporting CP–CD Nacional is now fully reviewed. Confirmed secondary errors are 16' Pablo Ruan missed yellow (against Sporting), 31' Leo Santos missed yellow (against Sporting) and 59' Geny Catamo missed yellow (favor Sporting).

Sporting–Nacional 53' remains disputed and excluded: Jorge Faustino says an outside-area foul plus yellow was missed; Tiago Antunes/VAR Bola Branca says there was no foul. Both views agree it was not a penalty.
Only confirmed decisions enter the public totals. Candidate and disputed rows remain auditable but excluded.
Major-error panel remains deliberately stricter than the all-error panel. Routine missed yellows do not count as major errors.
